summary: Backend-only testing of v2 real-data mapping + AI-inferred dynamic categories for Harbor project. 22/22 pytest tests pass. Verified: OTP auth + admin login regression; /api/demo/reset+simulate/next pipeline; /api/v2/w/{pid}/categories returns dynamic AI-inferred categories (People, Deliverables, Integrations, Decisions, Open Questions, Compliance, Milestones — payments-domain specific, NOT the fixed legacy Scope/Decision/Deliverable/Requirement/Commitment set) and is stable across repeated calls (persisted on project.v2_categories); /overview carries workspace name 'Harbor — Payments App Launch', dynamic categories, real connected sources (gmail/slack/figma/github/meeting), attention array; /memory items all use dynamic keys and counts match /categories; /people, /timeline, /sources derive from real DB; /reviews lists detected items with proposals+trigger; /attention surfaces conflicts after beats; live /ask returns grounded answer with confidence+sources via LLM; /threads/{connId}/draft returns non-empty draft + to; mutations persist (/reviews/{mid}/accept flips status to confirmed and removes from reviews, /dismiss removes from memory, /conflicts/{mid}/resolve clears is_conflict, /attention/{aid}/dismiss marks notification read); /api/v2/workspaces includes Harbor alongside p1/p2 seed showcases; sandbox p1/p2 seed fixture unchanged with fixed legacy categories.

minor.issue: Snoozed/saved sub-view (?view=later) always returns empty for real projects (hardcoded) — fine for current UI but worth wiring to notifications state later.
Returns ok:true even when memory_id doesn't match (res.modified_count==0) → silent no-op; consider 404 when applied=false.

critical_code_review_comments: v2_real.build_memory/categories calls classify_items on every memory read → re-persists v2_cat_map each call. Fine for correctness but a hot read-path write; consider short in-process cache or writing only when the mapping actually changes.

v2_categories.get_or_infer_categories calls the LLM synchronously on first access; the first /overview or /categories hit for a new project will block for several seconds. Acceptable but worth noting for UX (loading state).
v2_workspace.send endpoint accepts SendIn.to as object (`to: object = ''`) — loose typing papers over the earlier str/list mismatch; worth tightening to Union[str, list[str]].

v2_real.build_people uses abs(hash(name)) % 100000 which is NOT stable across Python process restarts (PYTHONHASHSEED randomised) — person ids will drift between workers/restarts. Use a deterministic hash (hashlib) instead.
No MongoDB _id leakage observed — all find() calls include projection {'_id':0}.
